title: Zdravljica
description: “A Toast,” Prešeren’s drinking song from 1844, set to music by the priest and composer Stanko Premrl. Its seventh verse, a toast to peace among all nations, became Slovenia’s national anthem in 1989.

title: Lublana je bulana
description: “Ljubljana Is Sick,” by Pankrti (“Bastards”), a Ljubljana band said to be the first punk band in a communist country. They formed in 1977.

title: Opus Dei
description: Laibach’s grim, martial cover of “Life Is Life,” a pop hit by the Austrian band Opus. The band took Ljubljana’s German name, which was banned for a time in Yugoslavia.
